prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: full-fidelity dark desktop portfolio landing-page direction comp, 1536 by 1024 landscape
Primary request: Design an unmistakably non-generic responsive website viewport for COLTON SPURGIN as a midnight risograph zine printed in two misregistered spot inks. Two offset voices—disciplined and curious—must overlap into the person behind the résumé.
Scene/backdrop: no scene; flat front-facing dark website interface printed on midnight-blue newsprint
Subject: a candid portfolio for an Air Force NCO, lead software developer intern, research assistant, and UWF senior specializing in AI graduating December 2026, who wants to build useful ambitious software and pursue a master’s degree
Style/medium: high-fidelity dark web UI using fluorescent pink and electric blue spot inks, open halftone dots, deliberate millimeter misregistration, rough small-press typography, and clear modern interaction
Composition/framing: use two semi-independent print layers across the whole viewport. The blue layer carries a brutal condensed headline “DISCIPLINE TO SHIP. CURIOSITY TO KEEP GOING.” and the primary navigation. The pink layer carries candid annotations and the role record. Where the layers overlap, a violet third-color vertical path becomes the reading order. Place COLTON SPURGIN at top left and WORK, EXPERIENCE, ABOUT, CONTACT at top right. Across the middle, four oversized stacked role lines read AIR FORCE NCO, LEAD SOFTWARE DEVELOPER INTERN, RESEARCH ASSISTANT, AI SPECIALIZATION · UWF · DEC 2026. Along the bottom, a blunt issue index reads 01 BORK, 02 VELLM, 03 TSP BENCHMARKS, 04 HOME LAB with one offset-print action VIEW THE WORK. Do not use card rectangles; typography, misregistration, and halftone fields create the structure.
Color palette: midnight stock #090b19, fluorescent pink #ff3f8e, electric blue #3f66ff, overlap violet #6b2a92, dirty white #eee8d7
Materials/textures: dark newsprint fiber, visible open halftone dots, ink gain, imperfect registration
Text (verbatim): “COLTON SPURGIN”; “WORK”; “EXPERIENCE”; “ABOUT”; “CONTACT”; “DISCIPLINE TO SHIP. CURIOSITY TO KEEP GOING.”; “AIR FORCE NCO”; “LEAD SOFTWARE DEVELOPER INTERN”; “RESEARCH ASSISTANT”; “AI SPECIALIZATION · UWF · DEC 2026”; “ISSUE 01 · SELECTED WORK”; “01 BORK”; “02 VELLM”; “03 TSP BENCHMARKS”; “04 HOME LAB”; “VIEW THE WORK”; “START A CONVERSATION”
Constraints: this must read as a functional dark desktop website, not a zine cover or poster; navigation and facts stay legible; use the misregistration as state and hierarchy; no portrait, logo, invented metrics, employers, awards, testimonials, or project claims
Avoid: generic hero plus card grid, bento grid, beige editorial portfolio, cyberpunk neon glow, terminal UI, cockpit, military insignia, clean vector perfection, rounded cards, glassmorphism, 3D device mockup, browser chrome, illegible pseudo-text, watermark
